description: A subset of an empty preorder has no least, greatest, minimal, or maximal element, no upper or lower bound, and no supremum or infimum.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.empty_poset_extrema_and_bounds.{u} {α : Type u} [IsEmpty α] [Preorder α] (s : Set α) :
  (¬∃ a, IsLeast s a) ∧
    (¬∃ a, IsGreatest s a) ∧
      (¬∃ a, Minimal (fun x => x ∈ s) a) ∧
        (¬∃ a, Maximal (fun x => x ∈ s) a) ∧ ¬BddAbove s ∧ ¬BddBelow s ∧ (¬∃ a, IsLUB s a) ∧ ¬∃ a, IsGLB s a
